title: Mysterious Metal Disc Beneath Baltic Sea

scenes.query2: sonar scan of sea floor disc
scenes.text: A 60‑meter metal disc rests on the seafloor
The Baltic Sea Anomaly was discovered by a Swedish diver team in 2011.
Side‑scan sonar shows a perfectly round shape with raised edges and strange metallic reflections.
Scientists consider it a natural geological formation, yet its exact nature is still debated.
